checked.found: Cato's De agri cultura (c. 160 BCE) gives the placenta recipe: cheese and flour cake baked and coated with honey. Date is the work's usual approximate date.
History of sugar: crystallised sugar in India by about 350 CE in the Gupta period. Approximate, but the usual cited date.

992 is the traditional date for Gregory of Nicopolis teaching gingerbread baking near Pithiviers, France. Sources call it a legend, not documented history. Description hedges with 'traditionally said'.
1296 is the earliest record of Lebkuchen bakers in Ulm, not Nuremberg. The first Nuremberg Lebkuchen maker is recorded in 1395.
1670 Cologne choirmaster story is a popular legend with no contemporary record. Description hedges with 'is said'.
Francesco Procopio dei Coltelli, Sicilian, opened Cafe Procope in 1686 on the Left Bank and popularised ices and ice cream.
John Hannon (Irish) and Dr James Baker began milling chocolate in Dorchester, Massachusetts in 1764.
Haci Bekir opened his Istanbul shop in 1777 (some accounts say 1776).
Franz Sacher, aged 16, created it in 1832 for Prince Metternich's guests in Vienna.
Richard Cadbury introduced decorated chocolate boxes in 1868.
J. S. Fry & Sons of Bristol made the first chocolate Easter egg in 1873.
Rueckheim's popcorn, molasses and peanuts debuted at the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition in Chicago.
Pearle Wait of Le Roy, New York (cough syrup maker) named Jell-O in 1897; Orator Woodward's firm bought and marketed it in 1899. Description's 'soon' is acceptable.
Hershey's Milk Chocolate bar introduced 1900.
Nabisco introduced Oreo in 1912; described as the best-selling cookie brand in the world.

Description has two errors. Christian Nelson was a candy shop owner in Onawa, Iowa, not Nebraska. The Eskimo Pie had no stick (Russell Stover removed it; the stick came with Good Humor), so 'ice cream on a stick' is wrong. Also the name says 'Patented' but the patent (US 1,404,539) issued 24 January 1922, while 1921 is the launch/naming; year 1921 conflicts with the name. Either year 1922 or name 'Eskimo Pie Is Launched' is needed.
checked.suggestion: Description: 'An Iowa shopkeeper coated ice cream bars in chocolate, creating a hand-held ice cream treat sold nationally.' Then set year 1922 (patent) to match the name, or rename to 'Eskimo Pie Is Launched' and keep 1921.

checked.found: Hans Riegel of Bonn made the Tanzbar (dancing bear) in 1922.

Origin is disputed. 1926 is the year of Anna Pavlova's NZ tour; the earliest NZ recipes are 1927 (a jelly) and 1928-29 (meringue); the Perth claim is 3 October 1935 (Bert Sachse). No source dates the meringue dessert to 1926 firmly. Description's 'Australasia' hedges well.
Mars Bar launched in Slough, England, in 1932.
Rowntree's of York launched Chocolate Crisp in 1935, renamed Kit Kat in 1937.
Enric Bernat launched Chupa Chups in 1958 in Spain.
Ferrero launched Nutella in 1964, from the earlier wartime hazelnut-stretched chocolate (Giandujot/Supercrema).
Introduced 1963 as Fry's Creme Egg; renamed Cadbury's Creme Egg in 1971. Name and description match the naming event.
Ferrero launched Kinder Surprise in Italy in 1974.
Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield opened in a renovated gas station in Burlington, Vermont, on 5 May 1978.
Dominique Ansel Bakery in SoHo launched the Cronut in May 2013.
